rules.statement: A person, although he may have one name, can use another name in his day-to-day affairs for various reasons, and that in itself would not mean that he was not one and the same person.
rules.supporting_quote: I find that in the deed marked 2V1, namely Deed No. 465, attested on 07-06- 1956, the person who became entitled to the lot E in Partition Action No. 3357 has transferred his rights identifying him as Pussawelage Podisingho alias Pussalla Gamage Podisingho, which shows that the original owner has not used the same name even soon after the final partition decree, which has been entered on 1st June 1955.
